ei.title: Chapter 4-12 3번: The Role of a Leader in Team Disagreements
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Project leaders should not be surprised when disagreements emerge within the team. In fact, they should expect them. If they remain hidden, the leader may even want to seek them out for at least two reasons. First, different views can bring with them good ideas about the project and how it might be run. Although snap decisions about project changes should be avoided, leaders should be open to new and better ways to run the project. Second, when conflicting viewpoints are found, they are more easily resolved earlier rather than later in the project. Although team members may disagree about one or another aspect of the project, most simply want their ideas considered and resolved. The team tends to look to the project leader to play the lead role in resolving differences, and members will generally defer to the leader if they believe their views have been given due consideration.

Second, when conflicting viewpoints are found, they are more easily resolved earlier rather than later in the project. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② expecting → expect: should 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 한다. expecting(현재분사)은 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ① surprised — 과거분사, be surprised(수동) 적절
✅ ② expecting — 원문은 expect. should + 동사원형이므로 expecting 부적절 ←정답
❌ ③ hidden — 과거분사, remain hidden(보어) 적절
❌ ④ avoided — 과거분사, should be avoided(수동태) 적절
det.tip: should + 동사원형: should expect (O), should expecting (X)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② conflicted → conflicting: 능동 의미(충돌하는)를 가진 현재분사 conflicting이 적절. conflicted는 주로 사람 감정에 사용.
det.analysis:
❌ ① bring — 동사원형, can bring 적절
✅ ② conflicted — 원문은 conflicting. viewpoints(관점)가 '충돌하는' 능동 의미이므로 현재분사 필요 ←정답
❌ ③ disagree — 동사원형, may disagree 적절
❌ ④ given — 과거분사, have been given(수동 완료) 적절
det.tip: conflicting viewpoints(충돌하는 관점) — 현재분사(능동): ~하는

det.korean: ① it → them: 선행사가 disagreements(복수)이므로 대명사는 them이 적절. it(단수)은 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① it — 원문은 them. seek them out에서 them = disagreements(복수). it(단수)은 부적절 ←정답
❌ ② how — 의문부사, about how it might be run 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '저항하는(resistant)'이 아니라 '열린(open)'이 문맥상 적절하다. 리더는 새로운 방법에 열려 있어야(open) 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① emerge — 나타나다, 원문 일치
❌ ② hidden — 숨겨진, 원문 일치
✅ ③ resistant — 원문은 open(열린). 리더가 새로운 방법에 저항한다는 것은 문맥과 반대 ←정답
❌ ④ resolved — 해결된, 원문 일치
det.tip: open(열린, 수용적인) ↔ resistant(저항하는)

det.korean: '반대하다(object)'가 아니라 '따르다(defer)'가 문맥상 적절하다. 팀원들은 자신의 견해가 충분히 고려되었다고 믿을 때 리더에게 따른다(defer).
det.analysis:
❌ ① expect — 예상하다, 원문 일치
❌ ② avoided — 피해야 한다, 원문 일치
❌ ③ disagree — 동의하지 않다, 원문 일치
✅ ④ object — 원문은 defer(따르다). 리더에게 반대한다는 것은 문맥과 반대 ←정답
det.tip: defer to(~에게 따르다, 존중하다) ↔ object to(~에 반대하다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 팀원들은 자신의 견해가 '합당한 고려(due consideration)'를 받았다고 믿을 때 리더에게 따른다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① immediate rejection(즉각적 거부) — 리더에게 따르려면 견해가 존중받아야 하므로 거부는 반대

❌ ③ discussed only at formal meetings — 공식 회의에서만: 본문에 회의 형식 언급 없음

questions.passage: Project leaders should not be surprised when disagreements emerge within the team. In fact, they should expect <u>them</u>. If they remain hidden, the leader may even want to seek them out for at least two reasons. First, different views can bring with them good ideas about the project and how it might be run. Although snap decisions about project changes should be avoided, leaders should be open to new and better ways to run the project. Second, when conflicting viewpoints are found, they are more easily resolved earlier rather than later in the project. Although team members may disagree about one or another aspect of the project, most simply want their ideas considered and resolved. The team tends to look to the project leader to play the lead role in resolving differences, and members will generally defer to the leader if they believe their views have been given due consideration.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 them이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 'they should expect them'에서 them은 앞 문장의 disagreements(의견 불일치)를 가리킨다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 팀 내 의견 불일치 — disagreements emerge → expect them: them = disagreements ←정답
❌ ② 프로젝트 리더들 — leaders는 주어이지 목적어 아님
❌ ③ 프로젝트 변경 사항 — project changes는 뒤에 나오는 내용
❌ ④ 팀원들의 역할 — team members' roles는 본문에 없는 개념
det.tip: disagreements → expect them: them = disagreements(의견 불일치)
